description: Ministry of Lab our and Foreign Employment - The Industrial Disputes Between Mr.J.L.P. Fernando Deputy Director, National Institute of Business Management Colombo - 07 and Other Part National Institute of Business management Colombo - 07.
categorisation: This gazette content concerns the repudiation of an arbitrator's award under Section 20 of the Industrial Disputes Act. It is a formal legal notice published in accordance with the procedures specified in the Act, making it a matter of legal/regulatory framework and compliance. The content does not involve government structure/personnel, land, commercial, elections, public service, judicial, or other specialized matters, and thus fits the Legal/Regulatory classification.
